from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import binary_fill_holes, binary_closing
im=np.array(Image.open('/app/chess_board.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
files='abcdefgh'
items={}
for r in range(8):
    for c in range(8):
        sq=im[r*80:(r+1)*80,c*80:(c+1)*80]
        mx=sq.max(2); mn=sq.min(2)
        dark=(mx<110); white=(mn>200)&((mx-mn)<25); mask=dark|white
        if mask.sum()<50: continue
        ys,xs=np.where(mask); sub=mask[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1]
        col='B' if dark.sum()>white.sum() else 'W'
        items[files[c]+str(8-r)]=(col,sub)
def filled(sub):
    return binary_closing(binary_fill_holes(sub),iterations=2)
blacks={n:filled(s) for n,(c,s) in items.items() if c=='B'}
whites={n:filled(s) for n,(c,s) in items.items() if c=='W'}
# report pairwise white vs black iou matrix
print('      '+''.join(f'{b:>7}' for b in blacks))
for w,ws in whites.items():
    row=f'{w:>4}  '
    for b,bs in blacks.items():
        bi=Image.fromarray((bs*255).astype(np.uint8)).resize((ws.shape[1],ws.shape[0]),Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        br=np.array(bi)>127
        iou=(br&ws).sum()/(br|ws).sum()
        row+=f'{iou:7.3f}'
    print(row)
